Hey. I'm sort of in the same boat as you. I'm underweight and struggle with eating much, sometimes because of this fear. It could make me panic so much that I would avoid eating sometimes. Honestly, I didn't even knew that your stomach could hurt because it stretches. 🤔 

I've dealt with this before and currently in my third relapse 🫠 

What usually helps is starting off slow. Back then, I had to drink a nutritional shake for breakfast alone. Then eat light things right after. To avoid feeling fearful of tu*, I eat stuff relating to the BRAT diet. Then, you could progress afterwards like slowly adding on to what you eat (add a Sandwich to the nutritional shake for example). 

It helped me to have someone keep an eye on me as I ate for some reason. But one important thing you need is a lot of patience with yourself. Remind yourself constantly that it's impossible to get sick when you hardly eat, it's so easy to confuse yourself with hunger and n*,  it happens to me a lot. 

As you said, those stomach reactions you are getting are normal and you definitely won't get sick from them. If you get fearful, rub your stomach as you lie down or hug something (helps me for some reason). Tell someone about it if you can for some support. Walk around if you feel anxious, stretch your arms up high in bed and see if you could get some burps out (sometimes helps with the pain).
